description:
abies is one of the deadliest viral diseases known to humanity, but did you know it's also completely preventable? In this video, we break down everything you need to know about rabies — how it spreads, the early symptoms, and most importantly, how you can protect yourself and others through timely vaccination and preventive measures.

നായ വീഡിയൊ
https://youtu.be/-9ZAF2tcvFQ

🔬 What You’ll Learn:

What is rabies and how does it affect the body

How rabies is transmitted (including animal bites)

Signs and symptoms of rabies in humans and animals

The importance of post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP)

How rabies vaccines work

Key steps to prevent rabies in both urban and rural areas

🚨 Don’t ignore a bite or scratch! Early action can save lives.

🐾 Whether you’re a pet owner, traveler, or healthcare worker — this video is essential viewing for understanding one of the most dangerous yet preventable diseases in the world.
